note: Golden Journeys per OMEGA-ULTRA-CONTRACT.md P9: product-level regressions, maintained long-term and auto-regressed continuously. status: automated=maps to an existing executable real-path command today; partial=real assets exist but the full journey is not yet one product path (gap listed); planned=spec only. 'command' fields are executed by `node eval/omega/threeway.mjs journeys --run <id>`.

journeys.name: research-question-to-plan
journeys.definition: 科研问题→检索→证据→空白→假设→反证→研究计划

mapping.role: browser e2e of the full product journey

journeys.name: paper-to-improvement
journeys.definition: 论文→方法分析→漏洞→复现→改进方案

mapping.role: rediscovery GT tasks approximate the 'reproduce established finding' half

journeys.gap: no single product path paper->method-analysis->flaw->reproduction->improvement yet; method-analysis and improvement-plan stages exist only inside the fixed pipeline for questions, not for an ingested paper object. Building this journey is Wave G product work.

journeys.name: data-to-interpretation
journeys.definition: 数据→理解→分析→统计验证→可视化→解释

mapping.role: real-path driver: dataset registration->QC->ExperimentSpec->real sidecar execution->mechanical StatReport

journeys.gap: visualization/interpretation surface is scenario-driver output, not yet a StudyMap-integrated product path (Wave G).

journeys.name: long-horizon-program
journeys.definition: 长期科研项目→多轮证据积累→实验版本→假设修订→协作

mapping.role: protocol entry that forces session-continuity scoring

journeys.gap: multi-SESSION evidence accumulation with hypothesis lineage and user steer is not a product path; scoring for cross-session continuity does not exist yet (OM-LH-01 exists to force it).
